title: Débutant — First steps
summary: Greetings, numbers, the present tense, ordering food, talking about yourself. No prior French needed.

title: Élémentaire — Everyday French
summary: Past tenses, shopping, travel, appointments, short emails and phone calls.

title: Intermédiaire — Confident conversation
summary: Opinions, the subjunctive basics, work and housing topics, longer listening practice.

title: TCF Intensive — B2 target
summary: Exam strategy for every TCF section, weekly mock tests with the CarnetTCF app, writing and speaking correction.

title: TCF Canada / TCF Québec prep
summary: Focused preparation for immigration requirements: expression orale, expression écrite and score targets.

title: Private coaching
summary: A plan built around your goals: work, study, immigration, or just the joy of speaking French.
